tasks.instruction: Write a discussion response. An effective response contains at least 100 words.

professor.name: Professor Gupta
professor.text: This week, I want you to discuss assessment criteria. Some schoolteachers give high grades (marks) only to those students who perform well on their homework assignments and tests. Other teachers, however, may give high grades to students who have worked very hard on their assignments but have not performed so well. Which approach do you think is better: Giving grades based only on performance, or grading students not just on performance but also on their effort?

posts.name: Kelly
posts.text: I think grades should be based on performance only. It's a matter of fairness. I'd be really upset if another student got nearly the same grade that I did when I turned in work that was almost perfect and the other student's work had incorrect answers or unclear ideas. It wouldn't matter to me if they worked harder.

posts.name: Paul
posts.text: Sure, evaluation should mainly be based upon the student's performance, but hard work should count for something. A student who works hard, even when the final grade isn't the highest in the class, builds character, which will benefit the student later in life when they go to university or apply for a job.

tasks.sample: I believe that academic grades should be determined solely based on academic performance. While Paul brings up a valid point that rewarding students for their hard work can help build character, there are other ways to recognize and encourage effort without affecting academic grades. For instance, teachers can give verbal recognition, gifts, or in-person praise to students who put in extra effort. As Kelly mentioned, grades should serve as a fair criterion for evaluating student performance and measuring how well they have learned certain knowledge. By using grades in this way, teachers and students can better understand the progress made and identify areas where more effort is needed. Moreover, a grading system based on performance can motivate outstanding students by giving them an impressive grade while incentivizing those who receive lower grades to apply themselves more diligently. (137 words)
tasks.title: Academic Discussion
